signed_rows.behavior: The skill .claude/skills/release/SKILL.md is named release, every -f KEY= it names is a release.yml input, its package values match that input's options, and every path it cites exists. A cited path holding a <tag> or <package> placeholder matches as a glob.
signed_rows.fails_when: the name differs, an input or package is made up, or a cited path is missing, or a placeholder path's folder is missing

signed_rows.behavior: The skill explains why release.yml and release-tag.yml both exist and that apm/apm.yml is kmctl's version source because users pin the APM package to the CLI tag.

.claude/rules/releases.md keeps the no --admin rule and every-release-has-notes, reworded so notes are reviewed in the pull request and a gap after publish is added by hand to the published Release (gh release edit --notes-file) and the committed .github/release-notes/TAG.md, keeping the reviewed text, with scripts/release_notes.py fixed when the draft missed a change; it names .claude/skills/release/.
signed_rows.fails_when: a rule is missing, it says to regenerate published notes from the script, it omits either the Release or the committed file, or it does not name the skill
signed_rows.command: uv run pytest tests/test_rules.py tests/test_release_skill.py -k rule -q

signed_rows.behavior: After the merge the skill watches the release-tag run (gh run watch / gh run view) and reads its ::warning:: or step summary naming late commits; its gap step adds missing entries by hand to both gh release edit and the committed notes file, and never regenerates published notes.
signed_rows.fails_when: the skill never names the release-tag run or its warning, or its gap step regenerates notes or edits only one of the Release and the file
signed_rows.command: uv run pytest tests/test_release_skill.py -k "release_tag or gap" -q

resigns.reason: plan round 1: gaps after publish are added by hand to the Release and the committed file, and the skill reads release-tag's late-commit warning
